title: Devastator — The Pursuit Above Tatooine
description: The Imperial dagger overtakes the tiny red-striped Tantive IV above a sandy planetary limb: layered armour, dark equipment trenches, eight heavy turbolasers, a terraced dorsal citadel, twin shield globes, a ventral docking bay and seven luminous stern exhausts. A connected starfield display supports both ships.

sections.name: Tapered armoured dagger and equipment trenches
Terraced dorsal citadel and command bridge
Three main and four auxiliary blue exhausts
